thought.text: ES URL is set. Now run the auto_wizard to seed the development database with the default admin user:

reasoning_content: ES URL is set. Next, I'll run auto_wizard (which seeds the development database with the admin@example.com/test user).

action.command:
docker exec -d zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/go/bin:$PATH"
cd /workspaces/workspace
export MEMCACHE_SERVERS=memcached:11211
export DATABASE_URL=postgres://zammad:zammad@postgresql:5432
export REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
export ES_URL=http://elasticsearch:9200
export ES_INDEX=estest.local_zammad
bundle exec rails zammad:setup:auto_wizard > /tmp/autowizard.log 2>&1
echo "AUTOWIZARD_DONE_EXIT=$?" >> /tmp/autowizard.log
'
echo "autowizard launched"
